Welcome to the home of Sammy the 17 year old Famous Mini Pig, his Bird brothers & sisters, Ferret sisters, Crazy Cat brothers & sisters, Rat brothers & Serama Chicken sisters!

We are here everyday just to cheer you up and give you a place to go when you're having a bad day. 

I create videos with all my animal children to make you Laugh and Smile.

Remember to Smash on that Subscribe Button and hit that Bell Icon so you will get notified every time we upload to YouTube!
